question: Should context-padding-only GitHub skills remain installable and publicly clean while their evidence is retained only in the durable reviewer-facing ClawScan record?
rationale: The branch chooses both a fail-open installability exception and a public-state projection for security evidence, which requires explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Reviewer-only durable evidence
options.body: Route the finding through ClawScan, keep GitHub installability clean, and exclude padding-only evidence from public suspicious projections.

options.title: Public suspicious state
options.body: Keep the artifact installable but deliberately expose suspicious aggregate state, with all visibility and API behavior documented and tested.

options.title: Fail closed
options.body: Treat context-padding evidence as suspicious for installability until a reviewer explicitly clears it.

recommendation.title: Reviewer-only durable evidence
recommendation.body: Route the finding through ClawScan, keep GitHub installability clean, and exclude padding-only evidence from public suspicious projections.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent GitHub-backed policy changes were committed through this person, making them the best available owner for the cross-cutting compatibility decision.
